svg.title: The sampled residual ranks the worst cases incorrectly
svg.desc: POD-DEIM field error and 24-point sampled residual for the five locked cases. The residual is anti-correlated with field error at Spearman minus 0.50, below the predeclared plus 0.60 gate.
